description: Build a 16:9 PowerPoint (.pptx) deck from a simple outline: an optional title slide, then slides with a title plus any of bullets (nested), a paragraph, an image (file path or base64), a table (first row = header; long tables continue on extra slides), a native editable chart (bar, line, pie) and speaker notes. Light or dark theme with clean, readable defaults; text plus a visual are laid out side by side. Arabic/Hebrew text is set right-to-left. Up to 300 slides. Opens in PowerPoint, Keynote, Google Slides and LibreOffice.

output.description: Where to write the result: a file path, or a folder ending in "/". Default: the server output folder (a temp folder unless --out-dir is set).

returnBase64.description: Also return the output as base64 in the result (only for small files). Default false.

slideNumbers.description: Show slide numbers on content slides. Default true.

bullets.description: Bullet points. Strings, {text, level}, or an array right after an item for its sub-bullets: ["Point", ["sub a", "sub b"], "Point 2"].

anyOf.description: Sub-bullets of the previous item (a nested array goes one level deeper).

image.description: The image (PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, SVG…): a local file path (absolute, or relative to the server's --root) or base64 data (raw or a data: URI).

table.description: Table rows; the first row is the header.

text.description: A paragraph shown above the bullets (or alone).

title.description: Deck title: adds a title slide and sets the file title.

name: ai_create_pptx
title: Create a PowerPoint deck
